body_text:
Your property might be holding you back.

Not because it’s bad—
but because your capital is tied up.

Most owners:
Buy → Hold → Wait (3–10 years)

Meanwhile, opportunities pass.

Some investors take a different approach—
they structure their purchases to potentially unlock capital and move again.

That’s what we call Property Banking.

transcript_text: Many properties owners buy and their capital ends up tied up. They buy, hold and wait 3, 5, sometimes even 10 years. But here's the challenge, their capital is tied up the whole time, which makes it harder to move or scale. What if instead, your property could potentially help you unlock some capital? That's what we call property banking. You buy right, sometimes at favorable entry price. You structure it properly, then depending on the situation, you may unlock capital through refinancing or exit. In some cases, investors may unlock part of their capital and reuse it for future opportunities, then recycle that capital into the next deal. That's one way some investors structure their portfolio to grow over time. Not just by waiting, but by structuring their moves. If you are curious how this actually works in Singapore, I'll be sharing this inside a free 2 hours masterclass.
